data_status_note: Retrieved Sunday 2026-10-11 (markets closed). Underlying quotes report top_status FROZEN; all option quotes report FROZEN_DELAYED, i.e. last available (delayed) values from the Friday 2026-10-09 session (trade timestamps up to ~23:59 UTC 10-09). Some option 'last' values are flagged is_close=true by IBKR (prior close, no trade timestamp). iv = implied_vol.annual_iv as returned (FRACTION, e.g. 0.34 = 34% annualised); option_midpoint_iv was returned invalid (isValid=false, annualIv=-15.87) for every contract and was not used. Greeks as returned by option_greeks (theta per day, vega per 1 vol point per IBKR convention); greeks were initially empty for 92 of 154 contracts (10s field timeout) and were filled from repeat option_greeks-only requests made minutes later against the same frozen session (all 154 now populated). option_volume was not returned for any contract (weekend) -> volume null. open_interest = callInterest for calls, putInterest for puts. Numbers copied verbatim (including float artefacts such as 9.700000000000001); nothing estimated or computed.
